old: Dense matching uses OpenCV’s StereoSGBM implementation. Experiments were completed to compare raw imagery, radiometrically calibrated imagery, and contrast enhancement. On one observation (Observation 003), the initial raw run retained 123,115 points, while the calibrated run retained 148,250. Contrast enhancement retained 129,904. These comparisons show differences in coverage, but increased point count alone does not establish improved accuracy. For example, radiometric processing can obscure the appearance of clipped raw pixels without restoring information lost during acquisition.
